headline: How I Think & Principles
bio: I am Sinatria Pamungkas, an Informatics Management student at Universitas Sains Al-Qur'an (UNSIQ) and a Full Stack Developer. I build web applications across the frontend and backend, explore practical AI integrations, and enjoy learning how systems work under the hood.

philosophy.title: Understand the Problem
philosophy.description: Analyze the bottleneck and user needs before writing code.

philosophy.title: Break Down into Components
philosophy.description: Deconstruct tasks into clear, testable modules with defined inputs and outputs.

philosophy.title: Design Architecture
philosophy.description: Establish clean data schemas, API boundaries, and UI states early.

philosophy.title: Build the Smallest Working Version
philosophy.description: Ship functional code early and iterate quickly without over-engineering.

philosophy.title: Test & Measure
philosophy.description: Verify performance, responsiveness, and edge cases under real conditions.

philosophy.title: Refine & Improve
philosophy.description: Clean up code, optimize performance based on real usage, and document findings.

corePrinciples.title: Simplicity Over Over-Engineering
corePrinciples.description: Clear, maintainable code is better than unnecessary abstraction.

corePrinciples.title: Verifiable Proof Over Assumptions
corePrinciples.description: Base decisions and claims on working code, tests, and actual logs.

corePrinciples.title: Understand the System, Not Just the Syntax
corePrinciples.description: Know how browsers, databases, and servers interact under the surface.

corePrinciples.title: Continuous Learning & Iteration
corePrinciples.description: Improve through practice, feedback, and exploring new techniques.

id.headline: Cara Berpikir & Prinsip
id.bio: Saya Sinatria Pamungkas, mahasiswa Manajemen Informatika di Universitas Sains Al-Qur'an (UNSIQ) dan seorang Full Stack Developer. Saya senang membangun aplikasi web dari frontend sampai backend, mengeksplorasi integrasi AI, dan memahami bagaimana tiap bagian sistem bekerja bersama.

philosophy.title: Pahami Masalahnya
philosophy.description: Analisis kebutuhan dan masalah utama sebelum mulai menulis kode.

philosophy.title: Bagi Menjadi Komponen Kecil
philosophy.description: Uraikan tugas kompleks menjadi modul-modul kecil yang jelas alurnya.

philosophy.title: Rancang Arsitektur Sistem
philosophy.description: Tentukan struktur data, skema API, dan alur tampilan antarmuka dari awal.

philosophy.title: Buat Versi Sederhana yang Berfungsi
philosophy.description: Kembangkan versi awal yang berfungsi dengan baik tanpa over-engineering.

philosophy.title: Uji & Evaluasi
philosophy.description: Uji performa, kemudahan penggunaan, dan respon sistem di berbagai situasi.

philosophy.title: Rapikan & Kembangkan
philosophy.description: Tingkatkan kualitas kode, optimalkan performa, dan rapikan dokumentasi.

corePrinciples.title: Kesederhanaan Lebih Utama
corePrinciples.description: Kode yang jelas dan mudah dirawat jauh lebih baik daripada struktur yang terlalu rumit.

corePrinciples.title: Bukti Nyata, Bukan Asumsi
corePrinciples.description: Ambil keputusan teknis berdasarkan kode yang berjalan, pengujian, dan data nyata.

corePrinciples.title: Pahami Sistem, Bukan Sekadar Sintaks
corePrinciples.description: Pahami cara kerja browser, database, dan server secara mendalam.

corePrinciples.title: Terus Belajar & Berkembang
corePrinciples.description: Tingkatkan kemampuan lewat project nyata, evaluasi jujur, dan mencoba hal baru.
